tournament.name: March OCC Clash Qualifier A
tournament.description: OCC CLASH MARCH SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - March 11 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline March 11 @ 1200 GMT) - (participation confirmation deadline March 10) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season. Round of 8 Finals - March 25 @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline March 23 @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
